items.title: OrbitDine
items.tagline: A multi-tenant restaurant management SaaS with digital QR ordering, kitchen display, and analytics.
items.description: OrbitDine is a full-featured restaurant management platform where multiple restaurant owners can manage their menus, staff, orders, and operations. Customers can browse restaurants by city/cuisine and place orders directly — all without a third-party aggregator.
items.features: Restaurant owner dashboard with menu management, staff management, order tracking, and analytics. Customer portal with digital menus, cart, order history, and profile management. Built with Next.js, Supabase, Firebase Auth, and Cloudinary for media management.

items.title: CarbonMind AI
items.tagline: Track your carbon footprint, get AI-powered insights, and reduce your environmental impact.
items.description: CarbonMind AI is a modern web application built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It helps users understand and reduce their carbon footprint through intelligent tracking and AI-driven recommendations.
items.features: Real-time carbon footprint tracking with interactive dashboards, AI-powered suggestions for reducing emissions, and a clean modern UI built with Tailwind CSS. Open to contributions from the community.

items.title: Galaxy Gym Website
items.tagline: A modern fitness website featuring sleek design and smooth interactions.
items.description: A modern portfolio website featuring web development projects, creative designs, and digital creations. Built with clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for a responsive, engaging user experience.
items.features: Focused on modern UI/UX principles with responsive layouts, smooth animations, and a dark-themed aesthetic that fits the fitness brand identity.

items.title: Royal Cravings
items.tagline: A full food delivery landing page with cart system, menu, reviews & newsletter.
items.description: Royal Cravings (RCB) is a beautifully designed food delivery landing page featuring a complete cart system, menu browsing, customer reviews, and newsletter signup — all in one royal experience.
items.features: Interactive menu with item cards, functional cart system with add/remove capabilities, customer review section, and a newsletter subscription form. Responsive design that works across all devices.

items.title: To-Do List App
items.tagline: A clean task manager to add, check off and delete tasks with minimal UI.
items.description: A clean and minimal task manager built with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Add tasks, mark them complete, and delete them with smooth interactions.
items.features: Minimal UI with smooth interactions. Focused on usability and clean code — no frameworks, just pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

items.title: Cake Selling Website
items.tagline: A beautifully designed cake shop website with elegant visuals and smooth animations.
items.description: A beautifully designed cake shop website featuring elegant visuals, smooth animations, and a modern responsive layout. Crafted using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for a delightful user experience.
items.features: Elegant color palette, smooth scroll animations, and responsive product cards that showcase the cakes beautifully across all screen sizes.

items.title: School Album Website
items.tagline: Celebrate growth, honor friendships, and preserve school memories.
items.description: A nostalgic school album website that celebrates growth, honors friendships, and preserves the legacy of school life. Each image and caption marks a moment in time — brotherhood, laughs, mischief, and shared glory.
items.features: Built with React and Vite, animated with GSAP, and featuring an interactive 3D dome gallery, an auto-scrolling circular timeline, and a cinematic autoplay soundtrack. A heartfelt tribute to school memories with a warm nostalgic feel throughout.

items.title: YouTube Bookmarker
items.tagline: Bookmark, edit, and instantly jump between your favorite timestamps on any YouTube video.
items.description: A cross-browser Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that adds a bookmark button to the YouTube player, saves the current timestamp, and lets you manage every bookmark from a clean dark-mode popup.
items.features: One-click timestamp bookmarking with a centered confirmation popup, edit and rename bookmarks, click-to-seek navigation, keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+B), video title and thumbnail preview, and JSON export/import. Built with Manifest V3 for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, and Firefox.

items.title: Study Buddy
items.tagline: A research workspace for students — citations, flashcards, highlights and tab management in one local-first extension.
items.description: Study Buddy turns any page into a research hub. Right-click any website to save it as a source, cite it in MLA/APA/BibTeX, highlight key text, and turn notes into spaced-repetition flashcards — all stored privately on-device.
items.features: One-click citation generation, context-menu saving, spaced-repetition review sessions, project-based organization, full-text search, reading list with due tracking, JSON export/import backup, and keyboard shortcuts. Built with Manifest V3 for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, and Firefox — fully local-first, nothing leaves the browser.
